user.title: Configure room heating
user.description: Creates read-only energy estimates. It never controls thermostats and does not modify Better Thermostat. Rooms are added one at a time on the next screen.

data_description.outdoor_temperature_entity: Enables the weather-normalised heat demand status per room: the last 48 hours of estimated radiator energy per degree of room/outdoor difference, compared with the room's own days.
data_description.wind_speed_entity: Lets the heat demand status learn how much wind raises each room's heat demand. Used only when a room's history shows a clear wind effect.
data_description.loop_order: One stop per line, in physical flow order: a label on its own, or `label|room_slug` to link a stop to a configured room (its slug is the room name, lowercased with spaces as underscores). A room with more than one radiator on the loop gets one line per radiator, same slug. Feeds the diagnostic "experimental cascade" sensors only - a room's own Heating system field above is what actually changes its main estimate.
data_description.loop_drop_per_station_c: Unvalidated assumption used only by the diagnostic "experimental cascade" sensors - nothing in this integration measures the real per-radiator drop.
data_description.alert_notify_entity: Choose a notify entity. Alerts remain off until you turn on the integration's Radiator stress notifications switch.
data_description.alert_observation_minutes: Send at most one alert per sustained stress period if the room remains over 0.3 °C below target and has risen less than 0.2 °C.

data.name: Room name
data.external_heat_entities: Heat pumps or external-heat binary sensors

data_description.initial_valve_hours: Leave at 0 unless migrating mid-month from an older setup.
data_description.better_thermostat_extension_enabled: Adds external-heat guards and opening-contact data. When disabled, the integration does not affect Better Thermostat learning.
data_description.external_heat_entities: Climate entities count only while hvac_action is heating. Binary sensors count while on.
data_description.stove_temperature_entity: Uses hysteresis so normal sensor noise does not repeatedly pause and resume learning.

error.invalid_room: Enter a unique room name, a climate entity, and positive numbers for power, area and radiator count.
error.invalid_sensor: The optional sensor entity must start with sensor.

abort.already_configured: Room Energy Optimizer is already configured.
